grammar.pattern: 把 + 对象 + 动作结果：再应用
grammar.purpose: Retrieve object handling in the chat
grammar.explanation: 把旧牌子换成新牌子 states an object and intended or actual result depending on context. 已经把…换了 reports completion; 要把…换 states a requirement. A plan is not a finished action.

examples.zh: 要把旧牌子换成新牌子。
examples.py: yào bǎ jiù pái zi huàn chéng xīn pái zi .
examples.en: Replace the old sign with the new one.

examples.py: yǐ jīng bǎ shí jiān gǎi le .
examples.en: The time has already been changed.

examples.zh: 把两条信息组合起来看。
examples.py: bǎ liǎng tiáo xìn xī zǔ hé qǐ lái kàn .

commonMistakes.wrong: 要把牌子换了，表示已经完成。
commonMistakes.right: 要换是要求，不是已经完成。

grammar.pattern: 被 + 动作：同一事件换视角
grammar.purpose: Retrieve the affected item in a passive
grammar.explanation: 她把时间改了 / 时间被她改了 describe the same event with different focus. 时间被改了 leaves the agent unnamed. No added blame follows merely from using the passive.

examples.py: tā bǎ shí jiān gǎi le .
shí jiān bèi tā gǎi le .
examples.en: The time was changed by her.

examples.py: pái zi bèi huàn chéng xīn de le .
examples.en: The sign was replaced by a new one.

commonMistakes.wrong: 时间被改了，一定是我改的。
commonMistakes.right: 时间被改了，还没说是谁改的。

lines.zh: 明天去新开的店吧，听说那里的面不错。
lines.py: míng tiān qù xīn kāi de diàn ba , tīng shuō nà lǐ de miàn bù cuò .
lines.en: Let's go to the new place tomorrow. I've heard the noodles are good.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 我看门口的牌子写着周五才开业，明天不是周四吗？
lines.py: wǒ kàn mén kǒu de pái zi xiě zhe zhōu wǔ cái kāi yè , míng tiān bù shì zhōu sì ma ?
lines.en: The sign says it opens on Friday. Isn't tomorrow Thursday?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 那块旧牌子还没换。老板刚在群里发了新通知。
lines.py: nà kuài jiù pái zi hái méi huàn . lǎo bǎn gāng zài qún lǐ fā le xīn tōng zhī .
lines.en: They haven't replaced that old sign yet. The owner just posted a new notice in the group chat.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 你把通知发给我。几点去？
lines.py: nǐ bǎ tōng zhī fā gěi wǒ . jǐ diǎn qù ?
lines.en: Send me the notice. What time should we go?
lines.speaker: b

lines.zh: 六点半。你把小周也叫上，我来订位子。
lines.py: liù diǎn bàn . nǐ bǎ xiǎo zhōu yě jiào shàng , wǒ lái dìng wèi zi .
lines.en: Six thirty. Ask Xiaozhou too. I'll book a table.
lines.speaker: a

lines.zh: 行，我问问她。她要是加班，咱们就先吃。
lines.py: xíng , wǒ wèn wèn tā . tā yào shì jiā bān , zán men jiù xiān chī .
lines.en: Sure, I'll ask her. If she's working late, we'll eat first.
lines.speaker: b

reading.title: Keep the facts and the people
reading.blurb: Original AI-assisted course writing; not adapted from a show or song.
reading.purpose: Follow what happened and explain the people’s choices from the text.

lines.zh: 小周在群里说她今天要加班，可能赶不上晚饭。我就把订位时间改到七点。
lines.py: xiǎo zhōu zài qún lǐ shuō tā jīn tiān yào jiā bān , kě néng gǎn bù shàng wǎn fàn . wǒ jiù bǎ dìng wèi shí jiān gǎi dào qī diǎn .
lines.en: Xiaozhou said in the group chat that she had to work late and might miss dinner, so I moved the booking to seven.

lines.zh: 她看见消息以后给我打电话，说别等她，大家先吃，晚上她再来找我们。
lines.py: tā kàn jiàn xiāo xī yǐ hòu gěi wǒ dǎ diàn huà , shuō bié děng tā , dà jiā xiān chī , wǎn shang tā zài lái zhǎo wǒ men .
lines.en: After seeing the message she called me and said not to wait: everyone should eat first, and she'd join us later.

lines.zh: 店里的旧牌子已经被老板换了。新牌子上写着开业时间，门口还挂着几张照片。
lines.py: diàn lǐ de jiù pái zi yǐ jīng bèi lǎo bǎn huàn le . xīn pái zi shàng xiě zhe kāi yè shí jiān , mén kǒu hái guà zhe jǐ zhāng zhào piān .
lines.en: The owner had replaced the old sign. The new one showed the opening time, and a few photographs hung by the door.

lines.zh: 我们把包放在椅子旁边，点了三碗面。朋友说这家店让他想起小时候的学校门口。
lines.py: wǒ men bǎ bāo fàng zài yǐ zi páng biān , diǎn le sān wǎn miàn . péng you shuō zhè jiā diàn ràng tā xiǎng qǐ xiǎo shí hòu de xué xiào mén kǒu .
lines.en: We put our bags beside the chairs and ordered three bowls of noodles. A friend said the place reminded him of the entrance to his school when he was young.

lines.zh: 八点多，小周终于到了。我们又点了一碗，听她讲今天发生的事，一直聊到店快关门。
lines.py: bā diǎn duō , xiǎo zhōu zhōng yú dào le . wǒ men yòu diǎn le yī wǎn , tīng tā jiǎng jīn tiān fā shēng de shì , yì zhí liáo dào diàn kuài guān mén .
lines.en: Xiaozhou finally arrived after eight. We ordered another bowl and listened to her day, chatting until the shop was almost closing.
